description:
Construct a custom raised stone planter in the front yard of the sample house.

Steps:
1. Open the 'Sample' house project if not already loaded.
2. Go to the 'Building' tab and select the 'Block' tool (sometimes labeled 'Custom Block').
3. Draw a closed shape (square/rectangle) in the Front Yard grass area to create a raised bed. Set the height to approximately 2-3 feet.
4. Change the material of the block to a 'Stone' or 'Brick' texture (e.g., Fieldstone, Red Brick).
5. Go to the 'Landscaping' tab, select a 'Plant' (flower or bush), and place it ON TOP of the stone block. You may need to adjust the plant's base height/elevation so it sits on the planter, not inside it.
6. Save the project as 'C:\Users\Docker\Documents\stone_planter.dpp'.
